candidates.reason: The existing candidate directly matches FARA sorts but extensional tuple identity collapses distinct parallel relation occurrences. Reifying occurrences repairs the defect and yields the selected kernel.

Typed nodes and identity-bearing hyperedges preserve the required commitments, but universal node/port/hyperedge machinery fixes an encoding style not required by FARA. It is retained as an exact derived view.

candidates.derived_view_condition: An explicit sidecar preserves nonoperational FARA commitments and is included in reconstruction.
candidates.reason: Bare transition algebra makes operation and execution structure foundational and does not natively preserve source/representation, interpretation, provenance, or occurrence identity. A charged sidecar makes it an admissible operational backend.

Typed disjoint carriers directly realize FARA categories; identity-bearing Event and RelationOccurrence carriers preserve repeated occurrences; operational semantics remain in the declared calculus or FARO layer.

conclusion: For Project FAR v1.0, FARA's canonical formal foundation is the identity-bearing many-sorted relational kernel. Typed-hypergraph and algebraic/state-transition forms are admissible derived views when their translations and required sidecars are explicit and commitment-preserving.

historical_result_policy.adjudication: The historical Pareto terminal remains true of the frozen candidates. Canonical selection is a later scoped architectural decision using FARA's mandatory gates, including the repaired occurrence-identity requirement.
historical_result_policy.fara-expanded-bounded-campaign-v1.0: Preserved as bounded Research evidence. No finite result is promoted to universality, necessity, uniqueness, minimality, or completeness.
historical_result_policy.fara-foundation-comparison-v1.0: Preserved as bounded Research evidence comparing the three frozen candidates under seventeen Pareto dimensions.

nonclaims: universal representation of every reasoning system
scope: Project FAR v1.0 finite explicit auditable representational architecture
selection_rule: A canonical foundation must satisfy every frozen architectural gate. A candidate that preserves commitments only through an explicit translation or charged sidecar remains an admissible derived view, not the canonical kernel.
